title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Systems – Collaboration
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.           The Experience        The Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Systems – Collaboration will be a key technical contributor within the Digital Enterprise Technology (DET) organization, responsible for the development, management, and administration of our portfolio management tools, including Linear and Airtable. This role involves partnering with engineering, program, and business teams to design workflows, integrations, and governance models that let teams plan and track work effectively at enterprise scale. This role will be critical to the successful launch and ongoing growth of these platforms across DET.             What You’ll Actually Be Doing         Own the architecture, configuration, and ongoing administration of portfolio management tools (Linear, Airtable) across DET.      Lead the rollout and scaling of new platform capabilities, from initial launch through enterprise-wide adoption.      Design and build integrations, automations, and custom workflows connecting Linear, Airtable, and adjacent collaboration/productivity systems.      Develop integrations between SaaS platforms and enterprise systems.      Automate user provisioning, lifecycle management, and operational processes.      Improve operational efficiency through automation and reusable tooling.      Establish and enforce governance standards, including permissions, data models, naming conventions, and usage policies that scale across many teams.      Partner with engineering leaders, program managers, and business stakeholders to translate portfolio and workflow requirements into system configurations.      Monitor platform health, usage, and performance; troubleshoot issues and drive resolution.      Evaluate new tools and features, and make recommendations on platform strategy and roadmap.      Create documentation, training materials, and enablement resources to support user adoption.      Provide technical mentorship to other engineers and administrators supporting these platforms.              You’re Our Person If…         You have 6+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering roles, including senior-level ownership of critical systems.      Hands-on experience developing, managing, and administering Linear and/or Airtable, or comparable portfolio management/productivity tools.      Experience supporting collaboration and productivity systems at enterprise scale, including large user bases, cross-functional stakeholders, and complex governance needs.      Strong background building integrations and automations (APIs, webhooks, scripting) between collaboration tools and other enterprise systems.      Proven ability to design scalable data models, permission structures, and workflow configurations.      Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work directly with engineering, program management, and business partners.      Track record of successfully launching and scaling new tools or platforms within an organization.      Experience with SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SCIM.      Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM).      Experience with REST APIs and automation scripting (Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar).      Experience troubleshooting SaaS integrations and enterprise cloud applications.              Even better if…         Experience with additional collaboration/productivity platforms (e.g., Slack).      Familiarity with scripting or automation languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript) for building custom integrations.      Experience supporting portfolio, program, or project management processes in a large enterprise environment.      Background in change management or enablement for large-scale tool rollouts.      Experience administering Linear Enterprise.      Experience administering Airtable Enterprise.      Familiarity with Okta      Experience with Infrastructure as Code or configuration management.                       Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     .      Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our      Candidate Privacy Statement      for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits.  Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.&#xa;&#xa;The typical base salary range for this position is $148,000 - $223,000 annually. &#xa;&#xa;The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description_html: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated  Senior Data Platform Engineer, AVP (Python/PySpark, Microsoft SSIS, SQL Server, ETL & Database Development)  to design, develop, enhance, and support robust, scalable, and high-performance data processing solutions.  The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on expertise in  Python/PySpark, SQL Server, ETL/data pipelines, Microsoft SSIS, and large-scale data platforms , with experience troubleshooting production data applications, optimizing database performance, and working across enterprise data environments.  The candidate will be working independently on complex assignments while collaborating with engineering , infrastructure, and business teams.    Responsibilities:       Data Pipeline & ETL Development:  Design, develop, test, and support scalable ETL/data-processing pipelines using Python/PySpark, Microsoft BI/SSIS, SQL, and related technologies.   SQL Server Development:  Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, data transformations, and database objects for high-volume applications.   Database Performance:  Identify and resolve query and database performance issues through execution-plan analysis, indexing, query optimization, statistics, and appropriate database design techniques.   Large-Scale Data Processing:  Develop and support solutions processing large data volumes across SQL Server and distributed data platforms.   Data Architecture & Modeling:  Apply relational, dimensional, and data-warehouse modeling principles to build scalable and maintainable data solutions.   Production Support & Troubleshooting:  Analyze failed jobs, data-quality issues, performance problems, and production incidents; perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable resolutions.   Job Scheduling & Automation:  Develop and support enterprise batch-processing workflows using scheduling/orchestration platforms such as AutoSys.   Big Data Platforms:  Work with Hadoop ecosystem technologies including HDFS, Hive and related distributed-processing technologies.   Data Quality & Reconciliation:  Implement validation, reconciliation, exception handling, logging, monitoring, and data-quality controls within data pipelines.   Code Quality:  Participate in code reviews and enforce development standards for SQL, Python/PySpark, ETL, and data-processing components.   DevOps:  Use Git-based source control and participate in CI/CD processes; work with container technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes where applicable.   Security:  Follow secure data-development practices, access-control requirements, encryption standards, and organizational security policies.   Technical Collaboration:  Work closely  with application developers, infrastructure teams, business teams, and other technology groups to design and deliver solutions.   Continuous Improvement & AI:  Evaluate new technologies and leverage approved AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality, troubleshooting, refactoring, and developer productivity.  Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm’s reputation and safeguarding the firm, its clients, and assets while complying with applicable laws, rules, regulations, and policies.      Recommended Qualifications:      4+ years  of relevant experience in data engineering, application development, database development, or related technology roles.  Strong hands-on experience with Python and PySpark for large-scale data processing and ETL development.  Strong proficiency in SQL/T-SQL and relational database technologies, preferably Microsoft SQL Server.  Experience developing and supporting complex SQL queries, stored procedures, database objects, and high-volume data-processing solutions.  Strong understanding of SQL Server performance tuning, including query execution plans, indexing, statistics, joins, locking/blocking, and query optimization.  Experience with Microsoft BI/SSIS or comparable enterprise ETL technologies.  Experience working with large datasets and distributed data platforms such as Hadoop/HDFS/Hive.  Strong understanding of ETL architecture, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and relational/3NF modeling.  Experience implementing data-quality checks, reconciliation, audit controls, exception handling, and production monitoring.  Experience with enterprise scheduling/orchestration tools such as AutoSys.  Experience with Git, CI/CD, and modern development practices.  Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes is preferred.  Familiarity with NoSQL technologies such as MongoDB is beneficial.  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.  Ability to work independently on complex technical assignments while collaborating effectively across teams.  Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to other developers      Education:     Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience                 ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Applications Development            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Irving Texas United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $107,120.00 - $160,680.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. Citi offers competitive employee benefits, including: medical, dental & vision coverage; 401(k); life, accident, and disability insurance; and wellness programs. Citi also offers paid time off packages, including planned time off (vacation), unplanned time off (sick leave), and paid holidays.
